opening: Hi Support, thank you for connecting. Our softphone on the reception PC has stopped registering. Let me know what you need.

responses.reply: Yes, you have my approval to change the network settings on this reception PC if needed to resolve the phone issue.
We already restarted the softphone application, and the computer was booted up fresh this morning. The desk phone has power, but the workstation phone client just won't register.

evidence.text: Customer confirmed the softphone application was restarted earlier.

responses.reply: The ethernet cable is plugged into the wall socket securely, and the link lights are on. Some internet browsing is erratic or failing to connect.

evidence.text: Physical ethernet link light is active at the workstation.

fallback: I'm not sure about technical details, but the softphone application shows unregistered and calls aren't coming through.
